description:
Sacrifice Tenacious Dead to Altar of Dementia, milling target opponent for 2.
Sifter of Skulls, Pitiless Plunderer, Zulaport Cutthroat, and Tenacious Dead trigger; stack the triggers to resolve in that order.
Sifter of Skulls generates an Eldrazi Scion token; sacrifice it to float {1} (Pitiless Plunderer and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger again).
Resolve two Pitiless Plunderer triggers, generating two Treasure tokens; crack one to float {B}.
Resolve two Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, draining opponent for 2.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from the graveyard.
Repeat the sacrifice-recursion loop, gaining one Treasure token per loop and draining opponent infinitely with Zulaport Cutthroat triggers.
